_comment: Committed list of paper_trades shadow rows whose LIVE NinjaTrader trade was closed by a person, not by the strategy. api/paper.py's nightly upsert adds manual_exit=<note> on a (leg, entry_unix) match, every night, so the mark survives re-upserts. The row keeps the engine's own numbers; the note says what really happened in the account. MANAGER #135, 2026-10-09.

entries.note: MANUAL EXIT 10-09 11:39 ET @ 31,071.50 (10 MNQ short from 31,027.25, -$894.50): closed by hand through the bridge on the owner's call. It stands in for NOISE's missed 15:55 ET close on 10-08 - a price-feed flap at 15:22 ET made NinjaTrader switch NOISE off with the short on.
